title: Towards Efficient Whole Page Ranking with One-Pass Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.05542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items, limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. Autoregressive (AR) methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning, but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. Bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking.   We propose Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. MIS integrates global candidate interactions, localized prefix conditioning, and position-aware scoring within a shared representation architecture. By comput

translated_title: 基于单次推理的高效整页排序
translated_abstract: 整页排序在复杂的布局与业务约束下，联合优化广告与自然内容，以平衡业务收益和用户参与度。现有的非自回归（NAR）方法能够实现高效的页面生成，但通常对候选物品的打分独立于先前已选中的物品，限制了其捕捉与顺序相关的交互的能力。自回归（AR）方法通过序列条件化解决了这一局限，但会产生大量的推理开销，给大规模部署带来挑战。弥合这种质量与效率之间的差距，仍然是工业界整页排序中的一项难题。我们提出了多物品打分（MIS），这是一种感知前缀的NAR风格框架，将序列上下文融入高效的多物品打分之中。MIS在共享表示架构内集成了全局候选交互、局部前缀条件化以及位置感知打分。通过计算……
tldr: 该论文提出MIS（多物品打分）框架，一种感知前缀的NAR式方法，在单次推理的高效框架中引入序列上下文与位置感知打分，弥合了整页排序中自回归方法与非自回归方法之间的质量-效率差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context, global candidate interactions, and position-aware scoring into efficient one-pass inference, bridging the quality-efficiency gap between autoregressive and non-autoregressive methods for whole-page ranking.
